Package io.foldright.cffu2

Class CffuFactory.IterableOps

java.lang.Object
io.foldright.cffu2.CffuFactory.IterableOps
Enclosing class:
CffuFactory
public final class CffuFactory.IterableOps extends Object
The Iterable-based variants (including Collection, List, etc.) of same-named varargs methods from CffuFactory. These methods handle multiple actions and Futures with the same type (aka. homogeneous).
